title: Field Report: fence cut, two padlocks cut, a jug at the ladder

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Distribution
fields.summary: Gate chained, but the fence fabric is cut at the northeast corner. The ladder-cage lock and the roof-hatch padlock are cut; the hatch is closed but unlatched. An empty one-gallon plastic jug with its cap off lies at the foot of the ladder. We did not climb, touch the jug or open any valve. Photographed and withdrew to the gate.

recommendations: Sample at the outlet tap outside the fence

snapshot.title: Orchard Standpipe Site Confirmed — Security Breach

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Field Operations
fields.summary: Orchard Standpipe site confirmed. Gate was forced open—gate contact ZS-612 tripped at 02:15 and 04:30 as logged. Ladder cage door is ajar, padlock cut with bolt cutters. No signs of a struggle. Interior is undisturbed. Sampling point near AIT-611 is accessible. Photo evidence taken and uploaded to MBW-NVR-01 under event ID ORCH-001. No other entry points observed. Waiting for Millbrook Police to arrive and confirm scene safety before any entry.

findings.notes: Gate contact ZS-612 tripped twice overnight. Lock was severed with bolt cutters. No evidence of prior damage.
Door is ajar. Padlock cut. No structural compromise beyond entry point.
Confirmed inactive since 07/2024 per MDWS-OTSEC-2026 Section 3 and C7. No operational verification possible.
Recording active. Video timestamp 03:42 shows figure near ladder cage. No video corruption.
Unobstructed. No tampering visible on valve or pipe.
Fence at gate access point shows evidence of forced entry. Cut wire visible.
All lights operational. No signs of sabotage.
Unobstructed. No damage to signage or pathway.
All posted notices intact. No defacement.
Camera engaged throughout inspection. Video and photo logs stored on device and uploaded to MBW-NVR-01.

actionsTaken: Photographed gate breach and cut padlock (photo ID ORCH-001_Photo_1.jpg)
Uploaded photo to MBW-NVR-01 under event ID ORCH-001
Confirmed no immediate threat to internal systems
Notified Control Room via radio at 08:05
Awaiting Millbrook Police confirmation before entry
Field crew remains at perimeter with PPE and body camera active
recommendations: Immediately notify Millbrook Police Dispatch (555) 038-7100 to confirm scene safety
Log photo evidence in ERP Section 5.5 and C5 as ORCH-001
Water Quality Manager to begin lab sampling at AIT-611 immediately
Begin review of ZS-611 inactivity record per MDWS-OTSEC-2026 Section 3
fields.photosNote: 1 photo attached: ORCH-001_Photo_1.jpg (gate breach, cut padlock, ladder cage door ajar)

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the physical intrusion and establishes the evidence chain. Watch for Security to call Millbrook Police and for WQ to initiate lab sampling.
